title: 29West topic resolution updates for changes through UM 6.17 release.
description:
These are the updates to the UDP based topic resolution protocols.  The updates
to the TCP based topic resolution is much more complex and has been split out
to preserve the wireshark teams sanity.

lbmc: add ranged_rx flag to ume_capability_flags

lbmr: change reserved field in remote_domain_route_hdr to be "route_index" route_index is a decimal number add!
 viral flag to the opt_local_domain_flags
